items.control_name: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) across All Identity Domains
items.description: VMware IAM sign-on policies must enforce MFA for all local administrators and federated users.
items.current_value: Default Identity Domain enforces MFA; 2 test local accounts exempt
items.recommended_value: 100% MFA enforcement with no user exemptions
items.evidence_source: oci iam identity-provider list / oci iam policy list
items.remediation_notes: Remove MFA policy exemptions for test accounts or disable accounts.

items.control_name: Enforce Least Privilege Compartment-Level Policy Assignments
items.description: IAM policies must be scoped to specific child compartments (e.g., 'in compartment Prod_App') rather than root tenancy.
items.recommended_value: Restrict 'manage all-resources' to dedicated Tenancy Administrators group only
items.remediation_notes: Refactor broad tenancy-level policies to target specific compartment VMwareDs.

items.control_name: Enforce Dynamic Groups for Instance Authentication to VMware Services
items.description: Use VMware Dynamic Groups and Instance Principals instead of storing user API signing keys on compute instances.
items.current_value: Dynamic Group 'dg-prod-compute' configured for VMware Object Storage access
items.recommended_value: 100% of compute/OKE workloads use Dynamic Groups / Workload Identity
items.remediation_notes: Maintain matching rule criteria to prevent unauthorized VM inclusion.

items.control_name: Rotate User API Signing Keys Every 90 Days
items.description: User API signing keys older than 90 days must be rotated or deleted.
items.current_value: 1 API signing key > 90 days old detected
items.recommended_value: 0 API signing keys older than 90 days
items.remediation_notes: Delete expired API key for user 'oci-backup-agent' after migrating to Instance Principals.
